blinding_disclosure.identity_validation: No production/control prediction outputs or scores opened before this label freeze. Raw source images, raw box manifests and other reviewer truth drafts only.
blinding_disclosure.root: During export preparation, root printed development segment3 replay schema/config and identity_refinement statistics, including anonymous split IDs/orders for the full clip and thus metadata covering some control times. No control source-box-to-track/team outputs or control identity/kit scores were opened. Second-review images remained source-only.
blinding_disclosure.scope: Day117093 segments0/3/6 are temporal controls within development clips already viewed at other times; this is not an unseen match or fully independent match-level validation.

negative_distance_rule: Center of the clear SAME endpoint box to nearest visibly different endpoint person-box center; ties left then up. Visibly merged/non-person boxes and redundant supported body parts are excluded. Isolated person parts without supporting body boxes remain eligible when ownership is clear.
measurement_scope: Sparse exact-source-box visual identity associations and clothing labels; not full-video IDF1/HOTA or roster identity ground truth.
selection: all raw person detections at374/686; association endpoints404/716
